subtitle: Out Cebu · Cathay Pacific
overview: Fly Cebu to Hangzhou via Hong Kong on Cathay Pacific and travel by private bus with an English-speaking guide. Explore West Lake, Nanxun Ancient Town with a rowing boat ride, the Taihu Lake scenery and Wuxi’s Nianhua Bay night laser show before ending in Shanghai. Five nights in 5-star hotels including a Hilton and a Sheraton. Shop visits are part of this tour.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Dec 5–10 2026 to Mar 13–18 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.West Lake: Hangzhou's famous freshwater lake, a UNESCO World Heritage site ringed by hills, pagodas and gardens.
placeDesc.Jingci Temple: A historic Buddhist temple on the south shore of West Lake in Hangzhou.
placeDesc.Leifeng Tower: A pagoda beside West Lake linked to the Legend of the White Snake; viewed from outside.
placeDesc.Meijiawu Tea Village: A tea-growing village near Hangzhou where the tour offers a Hanfu experience and tea picking.
placeDesc.Nanxun Ancient Town: A Jiangnan water town with canals and old mansions, explored with a rowing-boat ride.
placeDesc.Taihu Lake Eighteen Bends: A scenic lakeside road along the shore of Taihu Lake with winding curves and lake views.
placeDesc.Fool’s Wharf: A viewpoint on the south shore of Taihu Lake, visited for lake scenery.
placeDesc.Changguangxi Wetland Park: A wetland park near Wuxi with waterways and green landscape for a relaxed walk.
placeDesc.Nianhua Bay Zen Town: A Wuxi tourist town at Taihu Lake with Zen-style architecture, visited at night for a laser show.
placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's main pedestrian shopping street, visited for free time and shopping.
placeDesc.Starbucks Reserve Roastery Shanghai: A large Starbucks Reserve coffee roastery in Shanghai, visited as a sightseeing stop.
